name: Fake Microsoft 365 Account Security Alert
subject: URGENT: Verify your account within 24 hours
body:
URGENT ATTENTION REQUIRED!

Your Microsoft 365 Business Account has been flagged for suspicious login activity from an unrecognized IP address. Your account access will be PERMANENTLY SUSPENDED within 24 hours unless you verify your password credentials immediately.

Click here to resolve and verify: https://microsoft-security-login-alert.example-domain.top/verify-account
